# OsumFix Technical Services LLC - Full Site Documentation

> Complete guide and index to OsumFix Technical Services LLC in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

## About OsumFix Technical Services LLC

OsumFix Technical Services LLC is a leading provider of property maintenance, civil construction, HVAC servicing, electrical installation, emergency plumbing, interior painting, and handyman services across the Emirate of Dubai.

- **Head Office**: Office NO 4-173, Al Khabeesi Building, Deira, Dubai, UAE
- **Phone**: (+971) 055 1519540 / (+971) 056 7910188
- **Email**: work@osumfix.com / info@osumfix.ae
- **Website**: https://www.osumfix.com

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Air Conditioning (AC) Repair & Maintenance
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/ac-work
- **Scope**: Servicing split AC units, ducted mini-splits, central package systems, VRF/VRV units, and cassette ACs.
- **Key Offerings**: Deep coil chemical cleaning, refrigerant gas refilling (R410a / R22), compressor diagnosis & replacement, thermostat replacement, drain line jetting & leak repair, and annual HVAC AMC packages.

### 2. Licensed Electrical Work
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/electrical-work
- **Scope**: Residential & commercial electrical troubleshooting following DEWA standards.
- **Key Offerings**: Distribution board (DB box) load balancing, RCD circuit breaker replacement, emergency short-circuit repairs, chandelier & LED spotlight installation, outdoor garden lighting, and smart switch wiring.

### 3. Emergency Plumbing Work
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/plumbing-work
- **Scope**: Comprehensive water supply and drainage solutions.
- **Key Offerings**: Acoustic leak detection, central & electric water heater replacement, water pressure booster pump repair, high-pressure drain jetting, toilet & sink fixture replacements, and pipe re-piping.

### 4. Interior & Exterior Painting
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/painting-work
- **Scope**: Professional painting for villas, apartments, offices, and retail outlets.
- **Key Offerings**: Wall crack filling, anti-mold primer application, Jotun / Dulux washable interior paint, exterior weather-resistant villa coatings, epoxy floor painting, and wood varnish staining.

### 5. Masonry & Civil Work
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/masonry-work
- **Scope**: Civil maintenance and surface installation.
- **Key Offerings**: Ceramic, porcelain & marble tile laying, interlock block driveway paving, wall plastering, concrete repair, partition wall construction, and wet-area waterproofing.

### 6. Carpentry Work
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/carpentry-work
- **Scope**: Bespoke wood joinery and furniture repair.
- **Key Offerings**: Custom walk-in wardrobes, kitchen cabinet refacing, solid wood door fitting, lock installation, wooden deck polishing, and office workstation setup.

### 7. Steel Fixing & Reinforcement
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/steel-fixing
- **Scope**: Structural steel bar installation for concrete construction.
- **Key Offerings**: Rebar mesh tying, foundation raft steel placement, load-bearing column cages, beam reinforcement, and staircase steel tying according to Dubai Municipality codes.

### 8. Interior Designing & Fit-Out
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/interior-designing
- **Scope**: Turnkey space design and interior refurbishment.
- **Key Offerings**: 2D spatial layouts, 3D photorealistic renderings, mood board creation, commercial office fit-outs, luxury villa interior renovations, lighting design, and feature wall paneling.

### 9. False Ceiling & Gypsum Work
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/ceiling-gypsum
- **Scope**: Decorative and functional ceiling installations.
- **Key Offerings**: Moisture-resistant green gypsum ceilings, fire-rated commercial partitions, acoustic grid ceilings, recessed LED cove lighting profiles, and decorative ceiling molding.

### 10. 24/7 Handyman Services
- **URL**: https://www.osumfix.com/services/handyman-services
- **Scope**: Quick household fixes and mounting services.
- **Key Offerings**: TV wall bracket mounting, heavy mirror & artwork hanging, curtain rod & blind installation, IKEA furniture assembly, door hinge repair, and silicone sealant re-caulking.

## Service Areas in Dubai

OsumFix dispatches mobile technician units to all major communities in Dubai, including:
- Downtown Dubai & Business Bay
- Dubai Marina, JBR & Palm Jumeirah
- Jumeirah, Umm Suqeim & Al Barsha
- Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) & Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT)
- Arabian Ranches, Dubai Hills Estate & Damac Hills
- Deira, Bur Dubai, Al Garhoud & Mirdif
